source_status: official catalogue live/public; parsed official source instead of relying on Expomap alone
row_count_reconciliation: Raw Parsed has 652 unique brand/exhibitor IDs from the official PIR Expo API.
source_caveats: The official PIR Expo 2026 catalogue is live at pirexpo.com/exposition/all-exhibitors and backed by the public unauthenticated prd.api.pir.ru /brand/list API; Expomap is not the sole source.
The official API does not expose a structured country field; country/Russian-market status is inferred from public row evidence and the Russian-market official exhibition scope.

Cleaned/New/Repeat are restricted to normalized Russian HoReCa product/category evidence; service/software/event, packaging/disposable-only, blank-product, and no-product-evidence rows remain in Removed for QA audit.
Public website enrichment sampled home/contact/about pages only where the official catalogue lacked email.
CRM URL fields use production-safe public portal URL placeholders; local file paths stay only in local_paths for Kanban handoff and are not used as CRM links.
